title: Checking Work Without an Answer Key: Verification When There Is No Ground Truth
summary: A literature study: why checking is the lever, a ladder of checks, model judges and juries, combining weak checks without labels, calibrated guarantees, and a verification stack for agents.

title: Can Many Small Models Compete with One Large Model? Agents as a Multiscale Problem
summary: A literature study: when swarms of small models beat a single large one and when they lose, and how to build one on the heterogeneous multiscale method.
